title: Grateful Dead Live at The Ark on 1969-04-23
lineage: gen 1 cassette> tascam mkII>Korg MR1000 at 1bit/5.6mHZ>Korg Audio Gate Software>32 bit float/192kHz>Wavelab 6.1 for fades, blank tape removal, and slight channel adjustment>Weiss-Saracon for 24 bit fixed/196kHz Pow-r3 Dither

ai_review.summary: Rare uncut 1969 Boston show with a fascinating Dark Star; soundboard source is good but could use a little EQ clean‑up.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its historic value and energy, highlighted by an especially captivating Dark Star and the uncut Stephen>It’s A Sin>Stephen sequence. The soundboard recording sounds solid for its era, though reviewers note it would benefit from some EQ polishing to improve clarity. Overall the show is considered a valuable find for Deadheads.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed 5‑star reviews praise the musical performance and deem the recording excellent for its age, with only minor sound‑quality suggestions; combined weighting yields a strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear for a 1969 source; reviewers mention some muddiness and suggest EQ clean‑up, but overall the mix is solid and listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Uncut Stephen>It’s A Sin>Stephen segment noted; overall flow praised with strong historic performance.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's Gibson SG tone described as fat, alive and fascinating on Dark Star.
